"/tmp/launch_templates_$region.json" 2>/dev/null | sort -u) if [ -n "$lt_sgs" ]; then used_sgs="$used_sgs"$(echo ""; echo "$lt_sgs") fi # Get unique used SGs used_sgs_unique=$(echo "$used_sgs" | grep -v '^$' | sort -u) # Find unused SGs region_unused=() region_used_count=0 while IFS= read -r sg_id; do if [ -n "$sg_id" ]; then if echo "$used_sgs_unique" | grep -q "^$sg_id$"; then ((region_used_count++)) else region_unused+=("$sg_id") fi fi done <<< "$all_sgs" # Output results for this region if [ ${#region_unused[@]} -gt 0 ]; then echo "" >> "$output_file" echo "## Region: $region" >> "$output_file" echo "---" >> "$output_file" echo "**Unused Security Groups: ${#region_unused[@]}**" >> "$output_file" echo "" >> "$output_file" for sg_id in "${region_unused[@]}"; do sg_info=$(jq -r ".[] | select(.GroupId==\"$sg_id\") | \"\(.GroupId) | \(.GroupName) | VPC: \(.VpcId)\"" "/tmp/sgs_$region.json") echo "- $sg_info" >> "$output_file" ((unused_count++)) done else echo "" >> "$output_file" echo "## Region: $region" >> "$output_file" echo "---" >> "$output_file" echo "**Unused Security Groups: 0**" >> "$output_file" fi ((used_count += region_used_count)) done echo "" >> "$output_file" echo "## Summary" >> "$output_file" echo "---" >> "$output_file" echo "Total Unused Security Groups: $unused_count" >> "$output_file" echo "Total Used Security Groups: $used_count" >> "$output_file" cat "$output_file"
